DML.SELECT: SELECT command_element_type_id as "commandElementTypeId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", pm_command_element_id as "id", element_id as "elementId", queue_id as "queueId", priority_id as "priorityId", start_time as "startTime", end_time as "endTime", source as "source", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.pm_command_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.pm_command_elements (command_element_type_id, element_type_id, pm_command_element_id, element_id, queue_id, priority_id, start_time, end_time, source, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:commandElementTypeId, :elementTypeId, :id, :elementId, :queueId, :priorityId, :startTime, :endTime, :source, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.pm_command_elements WHERE command_element_type_id = :commandElementTypeId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId AND pm_command_element_id = :id AND queue_id = :queueId
